title: Nutritious Juicy Thai Sea Bass Boat Noodles
description: A light and earthy Thai dish featuring sea bass, this paleo-friendly boat noodle recipe is a cure for any seafood lover, with a juicy sea bass as the main attraction. This dish is made with a variety of spices and herbs to give it a unique flavor.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced shallots to the skillet and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sea bass fillets to the skillet and cook for 4 minutes on each side.
While the sea bass is cooking, cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce and lime juice.
Add the chopped Thai basil to the bowl and stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place some noodles in a bowl, then add a piece of sea bass on top.
Spoon some of the fish sauce mixture over the sea bass, then top with bean sprouts and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
